subject: OptiStore trial — ownership matrix & escalation cues
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@optistore.com>, Daniel Cho <cto@optistore.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — aligning success criteria and owners

Thanks again for the call earlier — short recap and a proposed ownership matrix so we can get your trial kicked off next week. Please flag anything that looks off.

Top-level asks from OptiStore on the call:
- Validate sampling latency for their real-time recommendation path (95th pct target <= 120ms)
- Verify cost per 1M tokens at expected traffic patterns (steady-state burst windows)
- Confirm data handling (no customer PII persisted) and audit logs visibility

Proposed trial success criteria (finalize by EOD Monday):
1) Functional: Stable inference at 75 rps with 95th pct latency <= 120ms across 10k token/day test corpus
2) Quality: Recommendation rerank NDCG lift >= 9% over baseline on the provided eval set
3) Security/Compliance: SOC 2 excerpt review + signed evidence that KV caching disabled for PII paths
4) Ops: End-to-end runbook for failover + a rollback/auto-fallback path during canary traffic

Evaluation plan (timeline):
- Mon (Feb 22): Seed dataset + baseline metrics received from OptiStore (Elena)
- Tue (Feb 23): Redwood deploys trial model variant + infra config (Marcus, Priya)
- Wed–Thu (Feb 24–25): Joint load run & quality checks; capture token cost run rates (Monica to monitor)
- Fri (Feb 26): Retrospective + go/no-go decision (leadership signoff window)

Ownership (RACI-ish, working draft):
- Trial infra provisioning: Responsible = Marcus Lin; Accountable = Priya Natarajan; Consulted = Karthik Iyer; Informed = OptiStore engineering
- App integration (client-side instrumentation): Responsible = Daniel Cho (OptiStore); Accountable = Elena Morris; Consulted = Priya Natarajan; Informed = Monica Patel
- Security & data handling verification: Responsible = Priya Natarajan; Accountable = Kimberly Park; Consulted = OptiStore security + Marcus Lin
- Procurement & PO intent: Responsible = procurement@optistore.com; Accountable = Elena Morris; Consulted = Kimberly Park

Attachments I dropped into the Drive link + attached the trial plan: OptiStore_POC_Plan.xlsx (high level runbook), SOC2-excerpt.pdf (relevant controls).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Elena / Daniel: confirm dataset delivery timing (Mon) and add procurement contact to thread if different from procurement@optistore.com
- Priya / Marcus: validate infra sizing and post canary rollback plan by EOD Monday
- Kimberly: confirm contract minimal terms (trial window, data handling clause) so procurement can start a PO
- Monica: prepare monitoring dashboard template for the trial (cost + latency + error rates)

I'll assemble a short one-page RACI and post to the Drive once Priya/Marcus confirm sizing.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — aligning success criteria and owners

Karthik — quick infra notes to lock down before we finalize the RACI: 
- For 75 rps with 10k tokens/day test corpus the minimal config I'm comfortable with is 2 x A40 equiv nodes with batch_size tuning. If OptiStore prefers lower latency at cost, we can add an additional node and enforce smaller batch windows.
- KV cache: we should enforce explicit opt-out at the model wrapper layer for any PII paths; Priya can add an environment flag and a smoke check in deployment.
- Canary policy: 10% traffic for 30 minutes, auto-fallback to baseline model on error spike > 3x baseline error rate.

I'll mark 'Responsible' on infra provisioning and will post a sizing sheet in the Drive by EOD Monday.

—Marcus
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com
